Eight persons sit in two parallel rows of four persons each, with equal distance between adjacent persons. Persons in Row 1 face south and persons in Row 2 face north, so each person in Row 1 faces a person in Row 2. The persons are Neha, Omkar, Tejas, Uma, Gauri, Jyoti, Ritu and Varun, not necessarily in the same order. Each of them has a different profession: Architect, Banker, Chef, Doctor, Farmer, Lawyer, Pilot and Teacher. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. Omkar sits to the immediate right of the one who faces Neha.
2. The Chef sits to the immediate right of Jyoti.
3. The Farmer sits to the immediate left of the Lawyer.
4. Neither Ritu nor Uma is an immediate neighbour of Jyoti.
5. The Pilot sits to the immediate left of Neha.
6. Neither Tejas nor Neha sits at an extreme end of the row.
7. The Chef sits in Row 2.
8. The Doctor sits to the immediate left of the Teacher.
9. The Chef sits second to the right of the Banker.
10. The Doctor sits to the immediate left of Tejas.
11. Uma is a Farmer.
12. Only one person sits between Jyoti and Varun.

Clue 1 splits Case 2 into 2 cases — Case 2a: Neha to the immediate right of Tejas and Omkar facing Tejas; Case 2b: Neha facing Tejas and Omkar to the immediate right of Tejas.

Clue 10 then places the Doctor.
Clue 8 cannot be met in Case 1bb and Case 2a, so they are rejected.
Clue 8 then places the Teacher.
Clue 3 cannot be met in Case 1ba and Case 1ca, so they are rejected.
Clue 3 then places the Farmer and the Lawyer.
Clue 11 cannot be met in Case 2b, so it is rejected.
Clues 11 and 4 then place Uma and Ritu.
Gauri takes the only seat left.
the Architect takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement (west to east): Row 1 — Omkar (Lawyer), Uma (Farmer), Tejas (Teacher), Ritu (Doctor); Row 2 — Varun (Pilot), Neha (Banker), Jyoti (Architect), Gauri (Chef).
